messages:
Elena: Heads-up — Enterprise customer (acct-6789) hit intermittent 502s and says some responses contained an email address that looks like PHI. Customer wants a minimal repro and assurance we didn't leak internal PII. Request IDs they provided: rq_20260317_01, rq_20260317_07, rq_20260316_22.

Sam: thanks. can you paste one of the raw request bodies (sanitized) and the exact curl they used? need headers + model param.

Elena: here's the sanitized curl they approved for sharing (removed real emails):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2","input":"Extract contact: [REDACTED_EMAIL] name: John Smith"}'
```

Jae: can you also ask them to run our debug-bundle collector with --include-logs and attach the bundle id? quickest repro is full request + response + kvcache dump. example: `redwood-debug collect --request-id rq_20260317_01 --out repro-bundle.tar.gz`

Elena: they said they can run it but asked for a simple redaction checklist first (legal asked us to confirm exact fields to mask).

Priya: minimal fields to pseudonymize before upload: emails, phone numbers, SSN, full names (when possible). prefer pseudonymization over deletion so we can repro behavior without raw PHI. recommend: replace with tokens like [EMAIL_n], [PHONE_n], [NAME_n].

Sam: agreed. share a quick jq pipeline they can run to mask emails & phones client-side.

Jae: example pipeline to mask emails + phones in a JSON payload: 
```
cat payload.json \
  | jq '(.[]? // .) |= (tostring | gsub("[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}"; "[EMAIL]") | gsub("\\\\+?\\\d{7,15}"; "[PHONE]"))' \
  > payload.sanitized.json
```

Priya: for logs (server-side) we need the bundle but with keys stripped. recommend they run the local scrub first: 
```
# mask emails in plain text logs
sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/[EMAIL]/g' service.log > service.sanitized.log
```

Elena: asked customer to run the debug command + jq/sed steps, and to attach the bundle id here once uploaded to the secure bucket. also requested one full raw response (with PHI masked) so we can check inference output shape.

debug-bot: Upload request received — temp upload bucket: s3://redwood-escrow/forensic/1923456789/ (expires in 48h). Please include bundle id in thread.

Sam: once we have the bundle id, I'll pull traces. prioritize request rq_20260317_01. I'll look for kernel OOMs, deployment fallbacks, and 5xx spike around 2026-03-17T14:12:xxZ.

Jae: also check the model variant routing log — if a fallback to an older quantized variant happened, kv-cache mismatch could cause unexpected token duplication. I'll grep for "fallback-variant" in the trace.

Elena: customer uploaded bundle id dbg-20260317-33 and attached sanitized response file response_masked.json.

Priya: I'll run a sensitive-data check on the uploaded files and confirm nothing unredacted escaped. If anything shows up we stop and coordinate legal.

Sam: good. if everything is masked, I'll pull traces and attach highlights. ETA 2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

Elena: thanks team — I'll keep the customer posted. sending them the masking commands now. :thumbsup:
